quarterly_data.quarter: L3Harris press release: L3Harris Delivers First VAMPIRE Units to US Army for Drone (10-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: L3Harris has started delivering VAMPIRE counter-unmanned systems to the U.S. Army, with initial deliveries arriving within two months of the Army's $106 million order; VAMPIRE has logged more than 350,000 operational hours since 2023 in support of European combat operations, and L3Harris established a new dedicated VAMPIRE production facility in Huntsville, Alabama earlier this year.
quarterly_data.figure: $106 million Army order; more than 350,000 operational hours since 2023
